name: tal rozen
headline: Technical Solutions Developer | Digital Adoption & Web Technologies
summary: Technical solutions professional with 3+ years of experience designing, developing, and implementing digital tools and interactive web experiences. Combines hands-on JavaScript development, UX/UI expertise, and user workflow analysis with a strong background in digital adoption, technical onboarding, and troubleshooting. Experienced in translating user needs into functional solutions, testing implementations, and continuously improving experiences based on real user feedback.

employment.title: Learning Experience Designer & Digital Solutions Developer
bullets: Designed, developed, and implemented interactive web applications and digital solutions based on user needs and operational requirements.
Analyzed instructor and learner workflows, identified usability challenges, and translated findings into functional improvements and digital tools.
Built web-based solutions using JavaScript, React, Firebase, HTML, and CSS, including interactive interfaces and reusable components.
Tested application functionality, investigated technical issues, and refined implementations based on user feedback.
Designed and delivered digital onboarding experiences, technical training, and self-service resources to support user adoption.
Collaborated with stakeholders to understand requirements, resolve usability challenges, and improve existing digital workflows.
